name: web_search
description: Search the web (DuckDuckGo, no key) and get titles, links and snippets. Use it for anything current or anything you do not know: news, prices, opening hours, 'who is', 'how do I', product specs, error messages. Follow up with web_fetch on the best link to read the page. Returns {query, count, results:[{title,url,snippet}]}.

query.description: What to search for; plain words work best

region.description: Optional region code like us-en, uk-en, de-de for local results

time_range.description: Optional recency: d = past day, w = week, m = month, y = year
